title: Chapter 145 Soul Devouring Clan
content:
Chapter 145 Soul Devouring Clan

With His Majesty here, do we still need to be afraid of a True Self Realm expert?

Let alone a True Self Realm expert, even if there are three, they believe that Her Majesty the Empress can still handle it.

At this moment, everyone's confidence came again.

Even the experts in the Deserted City nodded in agreement.

That's the wife of the Lord of the City. Although they have never seen her take action, they think that if she can be favored by the Lord of the City, her strength must not be too bad.

To deal with a mere True Self Realm existence, it should be enough to have a hand.

"Keep going!"

At this time, Yunqi saw that everyone's confidence was soaring, and hurriedly gave an order.

As soon as the voice fell, the army and everyone continued to rush towards the unknown border.

However, the next moment, everyone was dumbfounded.

At the border.

Buzz——

A huge wormhole suddenly appeared here.

The terrifying breath continued to pour out from it.

The powerful men of the Divine Dynasty stationed here in the distance saw this scene and immediately broke out in a cold sweat.

Could it be?

"Haha, you don't think that I am the only one here, do you?"

The shadow sneered.

It was the Shi Chen who suddenly appeared in the unknown border ten thousand years ago.

At this moment, Shi Chen looked a little ferocious. He hated Yan Lingyun to the core. It was hard to imagine what happened between him and Yan Lingyun back then.

At this time, the wormhole behind him began to stir again.

I saw countless strange creatures suddenly burst out of the wormhole.

These creatures looked weird, without a specific body, only a ferocious face and some weird tentacles.

Except for the shape like a human, there is no similarity with humans.

Hehehehe...

Weird laughter kept coming out of the mouths of these creatures, which made everyone present extremely disgusted.

What kind of creatures are these?

Everyone looked at each other, but all they saw was the same puzzled look from the other party.

No one at the scene knew the other party's identity.

This was a bit bad.

Fortunately, there is strength in numbers.

Just when everyone was puzzled, an old man with a hunched body appeared in the field.

"They are the Soul Devourers!"

An old voice came from the old man's mouth.

The voice was not loud, but it echoed throughout the border.

Soul Devourers!

Everyone seemed particularly unfamiliar with this race.

"Senior, what is the origin of this Soul Devourer?"

Someone in the crowd asked.

It was hard for them to believe that there would be such a strange race in the unknown star field, why had they never heard of it.

At this moment, the old man looked at the Soul Devourers in the distance, his expression extremely angry.

"Look!"

The old man pointed to the void around the Soul Devourers at the moment.

I saw that the surrounding void had begun to corrupt strangely at some point.

What's going on? !

At this time, the old man said in a fierce voice: "These creatures are born to devour all the energy around them. Their strength grows very fast. Wherever they pass, it becomes purgatory!"

"That's why they invade other star fields everywhere, and those star fields that have been invaded are no longer suitable for survival."

After hearing the old man's explanation, everyone suddenly understood.

So that's it.

At the same time, they also understood why Her Majesty the Empress has conquered all known star fields over the years.

It turns out that what she is sitting on is just a disguised protection of these star fields.

However, why doesn't Her Majesty the Empress say it directly? In this way, all star fields can be united without any loss to deal with the so-called Soul Devouring Clan, and the winning rate will be higher.

More than one person at the scene thought this way.

However, they didn't know that Yan Lingyun had thought about it.

But doing so is very unrealistic.

Because when the danger is not coming, no one will be willing to give up their own interests.

It's impossible.

So, Yan Lingyun chose the simplest and most convenient method.

Violence.

Use strength to force all star regions together.

Obviously, Yan Lingyun basically succeeded.

If it weren't for the sudden appearance of the deserted city, perhaps all the known star regions would have been included in the territory of the Divine Dynasty.

However, how did Her Majesty the Empress know that there would be such an evil and powerful race in the unknown star region?

Also, who is this old man in front of him?

At this time, someone wanted to ask about the old man's identity, but strangely, the old man had disappeared on the spot.

Without thinking any more, everyone stared at the Soul Devouring Clan in front of them with a tense look.

At this moment, the strange Soul Devouring Clan was still pouring out of the wormhole.

Among them, there were many masters, and even the strong ones in the Divine Emperor Realm were not few.

In this way, the strength advantage of the middle and lower levels on their side no longer existed.

Thinking of this, everyone began to worry.

At the same time, the forces in other unknown borders also began to partially support here.

The army that stayed here to guard the border alone was not enough to fight against such a terrifying army of the Soul Devouring Clan.

You know, the other side has existences above the Super God Realm.

And at this time, the strong men of the Deserted City and some of the Divine Dynasty strong men finally arrived here.

Looking at the terrifying Soul Devouring Clan army at the unknown border and the Divine Dynasty army facing it from a distance, everyone was shocked.

And seeing the people coming to support, the Divine Dynasty generals guarding here finally breathed a sigh of relief.

God knows how much pressure he is under now.

Although his strength is super god realm, he really has no confidence in facing the Soul Devouring Clan in front of him.

The gap is really too big.

Seeing the strength of the strong men who came to support, damn,

There are war gods, sword gods, and even knife gods.

This lineup is extremely luxurious. If he can't beat them, then he really has nothing to say.

"On behalf of His Majesty, I would like to thank you all for coming to help!"

"Yan Shenjiang, the opponent's target is all star fields, how can we stand idly by."

And in the distance.

Shi Chen also frowned.

He didn't expect that the strength here would reach this level.

It's almost the same as their Soul Devouring Clan.

You know, the reason why their Soul Devouring Clan can be so powerful is that the price is the complete destruction of countless star fields.

What's the matter with these strong men in front of him.

Where are there so many resources for these strong men to practice?

Shi Chen was puzzled at this moment.

Inside the Divine Dynasty.

Yan Lingyun chuckled and then retracted her gaze.

It seems that she doesn't need to show up for the time being.

At this moment, she actually regretted her actions back then.

She regretted being arrogant and complacent.

She was reborn here back then, and with her talent and the backhand she left behind, she quickly grew up.

She even became an invincible existence in that era.

The Supreme God!

And this is also the origin of the Supreme God Star Domain.

Originally, what she needed to do was to develop steadily, and then ascend to the Wood Immortal Realm.

In the Wood Immortal Realm, she had her own layout, and soaring into the sky was no joke.

Unfortunately, what she didn't expect was that a fatal threat suddenly appeared at the unknown border.
